nina (Docs): FYI I put up a tiny docs PR to add a short 'parse helper' example and a recommended fallback pattern for schema-based outputs. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4921

bryan (Eng): nice. can we keep the example focused on the non-streaming case and show the helper that returns a stable envelope? teams hit weirdness if they trust raw JSON from streaming.

nina (Docs): agreed. plan: show JS + py helpers `parseWithFallback` / `parse_with_fallback`, schema example (enum), and a one-liner about instrumenting parse_failures.

kai (DevEx): I'll convert plain JSON.parse snippets to use helper and add a tiny link to the SDK helper docs. also include a minimal test example in examples repo.

anya (ML): suggest a tiny note: when using quantized models you might see more tokenization splits—callout to streaming caveat is fine as follow-up.

ci-bot: CI passed. Lint passed. Staging preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.com/build/1638

bryan (Eng): left two nits on wording and suggested wording for the fallback envelope shape.

nina (Docs): thanks all, merging after deploy. will follow up with a separate snippet for streaming reassembly. :tada:
